$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for this manifest file

manifest_version.description: Specification version this extension conforms to

name.description: Machine-readable name used for CLI and APIs

display_name.description: Human-friendly name for UI display. This field is localizable.

description.description: Brief description of what the extension does. This field is localizable.

long_description.description: Detailed description for extension stores; supports markdown. This field is localizable.

icon.description: Path to a PNG icon file, either relative in the package or an https:// URL

icons.description: Array of icon descriptors for light/dark or size-specific assets

src.description: Path to the icon file, either relative in the package or an https:// URL

localization.description: Location of translated strings for user-facing fields

resources.description: Path to per-locale resource files containing a ${locale} placeholder, resolved relative to the server install directory

server.description: Server configuration defining how to run the MCP server

type.description: Server runtime type: "node" (Node.js), "python" (Python with bundled deps), "binary" (compiled executable), or "uv" (Python via UV runtime)

entry_point.description: Path to the main server file relative to the extension root

mcp_config.description: MCP server execution configuration used by the host application to launch the server

command.description: Command to run the server (supports variable substitution, e.g. ${__dirname})

args.description: Arguments passed to the command (supports variable substitution)

env.description: Environment variables set when running the server (supports variable substitution)

platform_overrides.description: Platform-specific overrides for command, args, or env keyed by platform name (e.g. "win32", "darwin", "linux")

tools.description: Array of tools the extension provides. This field is localizable.

description.description: Tool description. This field is localizable.

tools_generated.description: Whether the server generates additional tools at runtime (default: false)

prompts.description: Array of prompts the extension provides. This field is localizable.

description.description: Prompt description. This field is localizable.

arguments.description: Names of arguments accepted by this prompt

text.description: Prompt text; may reference arguments via ${arguments.NAME}

prompts_generated.description: Whether the server generates additional prompts at runtime (default: false)

keywords.description: Search keywords for the extension. This field is localizable.

privacy_policies.description: URLs to privacy policies for external services that handle user data. Required when the extension connects to external services that process user data.

compatibility.description: Compatibility requirements for the extension (client app versions, platforms, and runtime versions)

claude_desktop.description: Semver constraint for the required Claude Desktop version (e.g. ">=1.0.0")

platforms.description: Supported platforms; omit to support all platforms

runtimes.description: Runtime version requirements; only specify the runtime(s) your extension uses

python.description: Semver constraint for the required Python version (e.g. ">=3.8")

node.description: Semver constraint for the required Node.js version (e.g. ">=16.0.0")

user_config.description: User-configurable options presented to end users through the host application's UI

type.description: Data type of the configuration option

title.description: Display name shown in the UI

description.description: Help text explaining the configuration option

required.description: Whether this field must be provided by the user (default: false)

default.description: Default value for this configuration option; supports variable substitution (e.g. ${HOME})

multiple.description: For directory/file types, whether multiple selections are allowed (default: false)

sensitive.description: For string types, whether to mask input and store securely (default: false)

_meta.description: Platform-specific client integration metadata keyed by reverse-DNS namespace (e.g. "com.microsoft.windows"). Enables tighter OS/app store integration.
